community.title: Stories along the way
community.subtitle: Real places, small discoveries, shared by travellers.
community.emptyHint: Try another city or search. Only approved public stories appear here.
community.privateNote: Drafts and posts awaiting review are private to you and authorized administrators. Submission does not guarantee publication or a review time.
community.latestNote: Newest first. Only public, approved stories are shown.
community.examplesNote: Curated local examples, not traveller submissions. You can open them, like and comment, follow the authors and message them. All of that is saved only on this phone, never uploaded and never counted as online activity.
community.signInMine: Sign in to see your own drafts and review status.
community.deleteConfirm: Delete this story from your account? This cannot be undone.
community.draftNote: Private draft. It has not been submitted for publication.
community.commentNote: New comments await moderation. You can see your own pending comments; other travellers cannot.
community.commentSent: Comment submitted. It is not public until approved.
community.mediaHint: Up to {n} files. JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4, WebM or MOV. Videos up to {seconds} seconds. Reorder files to choose the cover; the server validates every upload.
community.uploadConsent: I own or have permission to use these files and consent to uploading them privately to this service. They will not be public until I submit a story and it is approved.
community.uploadReady: Files are ready. You can save a draft or submit for review.
community.uploadCheck: Check the file statuses. Failed uploads can be retried or removed.
community.publishNote: Submitting sends this story to the real moderation queue. It remains private until approved.
community.editReviewNote: Editing a published story removes it from public view and requires another review.
community.publishConsent: I agree to submit this text and its uploaded media for review and public sharing if approved.
community.draftSaved: Private draft saved to your account.
community.submitted: Story submitted for review. Not public yet.
community.report.title: Report content
community.report.sent: Report received. No automatic moderation decision has been made.
community.error.auth: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
community.error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
community.error.notFound: This item is unavailable or private to another account.
community.error.conflict: This item changed or the action is no longer allowed. Refresh and check its latest state.
community.error.rate: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
community.error.validation: Check the entered information and uploaded files, then try again.
community.error.service: The service could not complete this request. Nothing is shown as successful. Check your connection and retry.
community.error.mediaFailed: The file could not be processed or is not ready. Retry or remove it.
community.error.mediaTimeout: Processing is taking too long. It has not been marked ready; retry later.
community.error.fileType: Choose a non-empty JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4, WebM or MOV file.
community.error.fileSize: This file exceeds the service upload limit. Choose a smaller file.
community.error.mediaCount: You can attach up to 9 files.
community.error.mediaReady: Upload all selected files and wait until each is ready, or remove unfinished files.
community.error.uploadConsent: Please explicitly agree to private upload before sending files.
community.error.publishConsent: Please agree to review and possible public sharing before submitting.
community.error.title: Enter a title of 1–120 characters.
community.error.tags: Use up to 10 tags, each at most 32 characters.
community.error.poiId: The map place ID must be at most 200 characters.
community.error.media: Select up to 9 different uploaded files.
community.error.status: Only draft or review submission is allowed.
community.error.notPublic: Interactions are available only on public stories.
community.error.quoteChanged: The quote has changed. Refresh and review the latest revision before confirming.
community.error.model: Choose a model uploaded to your account.
community.error.quantity: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000.
community.error.material: Enter a material preference of at most 100 characters.
community.error.colorProcess: Enter a color preference of at most 100 characters.
community.error.notes: Notes must be at most 4,000 characters.
community.error.shipping: Enter a name, valid phone number, region and address. Check field lengths.
community.error.idempotencyKey: This request needs a fresh submission key. Refresh the form.
community.inquiry.title: Ask about making it
community.inquiry.noPayment: A manual production inquiry, not checkout. Feasibility, price and delivery require a real quote. No payment is taken here.
community.inquiry.signIn: Sign in to access your private models and production inquiries.
community.inquiry.frozen: This inquiry uses this immutable model version. Production suitability is checked by the service, not assumed from the preview.
community.inquiry.preferences: Preferences are requests, not promises of availability. The quote confirms the actual production options.
community.inquiry.privateShipping: Visible only to you and authorized production administrators. Never shown on community posts or public lists.
community.inquiry.name: Recipient name
community.inquiry.consent: I consent to sending this model reference, production preferences and private delivery details to the production service for a manual feasibility check and quote.
community.inquiry.unquoted: No quote yet. No price or delivery estimate has been promised.
community.inquiry.confirmConsent: I have reviewed quote revision {revision} and agree to proceed with these terms. This records confirmation; it does not make a payment.
community.inquiry.confirmed: The latest quote was confirmed. No payment was taken.
community.inquiry.cancelNote: Cancellation is allowed only before production starts. The server checks the latest state.
community.inquiry.manualSupport: Production has started. Online cancellation is no longer available; contact support for any change.
community.inquiry.needsInfo: Please check the production team's note and add the requested information below. Updating details does not confirm a quote.
community.inquiry.changed: The inquiry or quote changed. The latest details are shown; please review before taking another action.
community.inquiry.emptyHint: Create a keepsake and upload a model to ask about production.
community.admin.title: Along · Operations
community.admin.subtitle: Moderation and manual production · authorized accounts only
community.admin.codeSent: A sign-in code was requested. Check your email.
community.admin.denied: This account cannot access administration. Authorization is checked by the server on every request.
community.admin.authUnavailable: Email sign-in is not configured. This page cannot create an admin account or bypass authentication.
community.admin.reportNotice: Resolving a report does not hide its target. Moderate the story or comment separately if needed.
community.admin.quoteNotice: A new revision replaces the previous quote. The owner must explicitly confirm the latest revision before production.
community.admin.stateNotice: The service rechecks transitions. Shipment requires a real carrier and tracking number; do not mark shipped before dispatch.
community.admin.quoteInvalid: Enter valid CNY amounts (up to two decimals) and a positive whole-number lead time.
community.admin.shippingRequired: Enter the actual carrier and tracking number before marking shipped.
community.admin.loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check the code or request a new one.
